says: Under the 260× day-one diary, commenters argue that a CO2 laser beats any cream, ask which brand she's using, share their own months-long tretinoin results and push isotretinoin instead. Several of the most-liked viewer questions from run 1 belong here: "Can you make a video on retinol vs tretinoin?" (1,156 likes), a request for a budget-friendly retinoid (1,116), surprise that a derm uses a retinoid with no moisturizer (600), and a 15% azelaic user asking whether a month of stinging means stop or push on. People want a straight rule for which retinoid, how often and what's normal.
